correctness.rationale: Uniform barycentric coordinates lambda are Dirichlet(1,...,1) with C=(mI-J)/[m²(m+1)] positive definite, m=d+1. Setting v0=0 and edge Gram G yields Y_i=G_ii-2(G lambda)_i, hence S=4GCG. The unique SPD square root of C^1/2 S C^1/2 recovers G=1/2 C^-1/2 (C^1/2 S C^1/2)^1/2 C^-1/2 for every d>=1. Each SPD S yields a unique SPD Gram and thus an isometry class of labelled simplices. det C=[m^(d+1)(m+1)^d]^-1 and det G=(d!Vol)^2 give the displayed volume formula. Independently checked symbolic exact identities for d=1,2,3; all-dimensional proof is SPD algebra, not finite tests.
residual_risks: Uniform sampling and known labelling are essential; singular covariances and empirical covariance perturbations are outside scope.
